messages.subject: SEM - multigroup
parts:
Hi all, 
I'm new to this group, so sorry if I may not comply with the group-netiquette. 

I'm working with SEM in social-mobility framework as I want to use different survey-questions to define the cognitive ability as a latent factor and in turn use it as an exogenous regression path. 
The model is defined as follows: 

sem<- ' 
#Measurement model - latent variables  
ability =~ c_cgwri_dv + c_cgwrd_dv + c_cgs7ca_dv + c_cgvfc_dv + c_cgna_dv
education=~edu_r 
r_class=~respondent_class 
o_class=~max_class 
agree =~ c_big5a_dv 
consc =~ c_big5c_dv
neur =~ c_big5n_dv 
open =~ c_big5o_dv 
extro =~ c_big5e_dv 

#Structural model - Pahts 
ability ~ a*o_class 
education ~ b*ability + c*o_class + d*agree + e*consc + f*neur + g*open + h*extro 
r_class ~ i*education + l*ability + m*o_class + n*agree + o*consc + p*neur + q*open + r*extro 

#Indirect effects: 
i_ability := b*i 
i_originclass := (a*l) + (c*i) + (a*b*i)
i_agree := d*i 
i_consc := e*i 
i_neur := f*i 
i_open := g*i 
i_extro := h*i 

#Correlations
c_cgwri_dv ~~ c_cgwrd_dv
c_cgs7ca_dv ~~ c_cgna_dv
c_cgwri_dv ~~ c_cgvfc_dv
c_cgwrd_dv ~~ c_cgvfc_dv
c_cgvfc_dv ~~ c_cgna_dv
c_cgs7ca_dv ~~ c_cgvfc_dv
agree ~~ ability 
consc ~~ ability 
neur ~~ ability 
open ~~ ability 
extro ~~ ability
o_class ~~ agree + consc + neur + open + extro
'

I want to perform a multi-group analysis by gender and therefore I was comparing the free and constrained model to check for differences. The ANOVA reveals significant differences, but now I have some troubles. Indeed, constraining and relaxing the possible paths would be exhausting and inefficient, nor desirable. If I fix the regression paths based on theory and assumptions and let free some important variables (education, origin and ability), then how can I check whether the unstandardized coefficient between males and females are significantly different? 

Thanks for your help! 

Luca

Thanks for your quick reply! 
I didn't know the command lavTestScore and I don't think I really get how it works. 
As far as I understood, I should use the option release, which will set free my constrains, but what does it tell me about the difference between the already free parameters between males and females? 
I mean, I have my "table" with the parameter estimates: 

est <- parTable(gender_boost)
> View(est)
> est[est$op %in% c("~"), ]

how can I correctly implement lavTestScore to test the parameter-operation I've decided to be free between the two groups? 

Thanks a lot for your help 

Luca
